# circubAwd

> circubAwd is a free market research tool powered by real locals: real,
> current prices for everyday things in any city - food, transport, hotels,
> services - cash-bounty questions answered by people who live there in
> minutes, an AI price scanner, an itemized proforma cost estimator, and
> registered Sales sellers. Installable as a mobile app (PWA) on Android,
> iOS and desktop; no app store needed.

circubAwd ("the best market research tool is the crowd that lives there") is
built on one idea: the most reliable market data comes from people who
actually live there. Locals post prices for products, services, restaurants
and transport in their own city and currency. The community votes and rates
posts, so accurate data rises to the top. Researchers, travelers and buyers
build a proforma list and see what their budget covers in each place, scan
any item with the AI price scanner (PriceLens), or put a cash bounty on any
question a local can answer in minutes.

## What you can do with circubAwd

- **Post real prices** (free account): name an item, its price, currency and
  place - optional photo - so the next person isn't guessing.
- **Do market research**: ask any city or country question, or post a cash
  bounty for shop checks, photos and field answers - locals reply in minutes.
- **Plan a budget**: list what you plan to buy and see what to set aside
  per place, with a budget locator that ranks where your money covers the
  whole list.
- **Scan with PriceLens**: point your camera at any item and see what it
  typically costs nearby, backed by community prices.
- **Book local talents**: find verified locals by city, language and
  specialty, with star ratings - for fieldwork, shop checks or full trips.
- **Vote and rate**: community votes and star ratings surface the most
  accurate prices and the most helpful locals.

## Key facts

- Website: https://circubawd.vercel.app
- Platforms: any browser; installable PWA (Android, iOS, desktop)
- Price: free
- Languages: English, Amharic, Kiswahili, Arabic, French, Chinese
- Contact: https://circubawd.vercel.app/contact (support@tenetbid.com)
